{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|the phrase "son of a murglak"|[[Murglak/Legends|murglak]], or the similar phrase "[[Son of a bantha/Legends|son of a bantha]]"}}
{{Quote|Kriffin' son of a murglak broke my kriffin' nose.|Khedryn Faal to himself, following an encounter with Kell Douro|<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>}}
"'''Son of a [[Murglak/Legends|murglak]]'''" was a disparaging phrase used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], serving both as an exclamation and an insult.

==History==
{{Quote|You are one stupid son of a murglak.|Vilmarh Grahrk to Holmar Grahrk|<ref name="Republic 21">[[Star Wars (1998) 21|''Star Wars'' (1998) 21]]</ref>}}
===Old Republic===
When [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Holmar Grahrk]] joined forces with his cousin [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], Vilmarh scolded [[Gender/Legends|him]], calling him "one stupid son of a [[Murglak/Legends|murglak]]" for talking to him openly. He explained that when people saw two [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] together, they would rightly suspect they were plotting something.<ref name="Republic 21" /> 

[[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] [[Sagoro Autem]] exclaimed, "Ah, son of a murglak!" upon being assigned to a [[Death/Legends|murder]] investigation and realizing that the victim was [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jheramahd Greyshade]].<ref name="Republic 46">[[Republic 46|''Republic'' 46]]</ref>

===New Republic===
When [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Khedryn Faal]] encountered the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kell Douro]], Duoro ended up breaking Khedryn's [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and right [[Limb/Legends|wrist]]. Following the encounter, Faal grumbled to himself that the "[[Kriff/Legends|kriffin]]' son of a murglak broke my kriffin' nose."<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

===New Sith Order===
While apprehending [[Naxy Screeger]] for a bounty, the bounty hunter [[Cade Skywalker]] angrily threw Screeger across the room. Screeger's body ended up crashing into Skywalker's partner, [[Jariah Syn]], who exclaimed, "son of a murglak!"<ref name="Legacy 2">[[Legacy (2006) 2|''Legacy'' (2006) 2]]</ref>

When Syn learned that Skywalker used to be a [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi]], Skywalker accused him of intending to shoot him in the back as soon as he wasn't looking, to claim the bounty on his head. Furious, Syn shot back, "No, you son of a murglak! I'll shoot you right in your face!"<ref name="Legacy 6">[[Legacy (2006) 6|''Legacy'' (2006) 6]]</ref>

While being [[Skirmish at the Temple of the Sith|rescued from the Sith temple]], Skywalker leaped out of the [[Window/Legends|window]] and landed inside the waiting [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], where Syn caught him and exclaimed, "son of a murglak!" once again.<ref name="Legacy 19">[[Legacy (2006) 19|''Legacy'' (2006) 19]]</ref>

When Skywalker went to the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]], he unknowingly had a group of [[Imperial Knight]]s trailing him, prompting him to shout "son of a murglak!" when he spotted them.<ref name="Legacy 25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref>

During a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Gunn Yage]] had no choice but to team up with Skywalker to make it through. The two began to fight when Yage discovered that Skywalker had a spare [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreather]] with him the entire time. Enraged, Yage yelled, "You stinking son of a murglak!" and accused him of planning to let her die. When Skywalker led them to the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] to take shelter from the storm, Yage, frustrated, called him a "strekkin' son of a murglak…!"<ref name="Legacy 39">[[Legacy (2006) 39|''Legacy'' (2006) 39]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"Son of a [[Murglak/Legends|murglak]]" is similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son of a bitch,"<ref name="Son of a">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/son-of-a-bitch|text=son of a bitch|quote=''vulgar slang'' • '''1.''' a contemptible or thoroughly disagreeable person; scoundrel '''2.''' a disagreeable matter; a chore '''3.''' (used as an exclamation of impatience, irritation, astonishment, etc.)|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ZuHS2}}</ref> which also exists in [[Star Wars Legends|Legends continuity]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> Similar phrases from Legends include "son-of-a-[[Kath hound/Legends|kath-hound]],"<ref name="Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> "son of a [[monkey-lizard]],"<ref name="The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref> "[[Son of a bantha/Legends|son of a bantha]],"<ref name="A Tangled Web">''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]''</ref> "son-of-a-[[Mynock/Legends|mynock]],"<ref name="ThonBoka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref> "son of a [[rancor]]"<ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref> and "son of a [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]]."<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>
